youth.analysis_en: From Seeking the Aid of Great Men (Royalty & Polity), Kural 445 speaks directly to teens navigating studies, friendships, leadership, and digital choices: As a king must use his ministers as eyes (in managing his kingdom), let him well examine their character and qualifications before he engages them.
